{'text': 'According to web traffic analytics shared with 9to5Mac, Apple is testing iOS 27.0.1 for iPhones. The update is expected to focus on bug fixes and performance improvements.', 'trans': '根據 9to5Mac 的網絡流量分析數據，Apple 正在測試 iPhone 用的 iOS 27.0.1。是次更新預計會集中於修復錯誤及提升效能表現。'}

{'text': 'iOS 27.0.1 is on the way', 'trans': 'iOS 27.0.1 即將推出'}

{'text': "9to5Mac's analytics started showing signs of iOS 27.0.1 a few days ago, and MacRumors also has coverage.", 'trans': '9to5Mac 的分析數據於數日前開始出現 iOS 27.0.1 的蹤跡，MacRumors 亦有相關報道。'}

{'text': 'Apple told 9to5Mac this morning that it will release a software update early next week that addresses an issue where some iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max devices unexpectedly reboot after a failed Face ID match.', 'trans': 'Apple 今早向 9to5Mac 表示，將會於下週初發佈軟件更新，以修正部分 iPhone 18 Pro 及 Pro Max 機款在 Face ID 識別失敗後重新啟動的問題。'}

{'text': 'We covered this issue earlier this week, explaining that it occurs when you try to use Face ID to unlock apps like Passwords. Once Face ID fails, your iPhone may unexpectedly reboot.', 'trans': '我們本週初已就該問題作出報道，解釋指問題會於你嘗試以 Face ID 解鎖 Passwords 等應用程式時發生。一旦 Face ID 識別失敗，你的 iPhone 可能會意外重新啟動。'}

{'text': 'I was never able to reproduce the issue on either my iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max, but clearly some users are affected. The good news is this is a software-fixable bug, not any kind of hardware issue.', 'trans': '我從未能在自己的 iPhone 18 Pro 或 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上重現這個問題，但明顯有部分用戶受到影響。好消息是，這是一個可透過軟件修正的錯誤，而非任何硬件故障。'}

{'text': 'While unconfirmed, iOS 27.0.1 will likely address this issue. The update could also include other fixes for iOS 27 bugs and iPhone 18 Pro hardware issues.', 'trans': '雖然並未獲確認，但 iOS 27.0.1 有機會解決上述問題。是次更新亦可能會包含其他針對 iOS 27 以及全新 iPhone 18 Pro 硬件錯誤的修正。'}

{'text': 'Have you experienced any issues since updating to iOS 27? What about iPhone 18 Pro-specific issues? Let us know in the comments.', 'trans': '你自從升級至 iOS 27 之後有否遇到任何問題？iPhone 18 Pro 專屬的問題又如何？歡迎於下方留言告訴我們。'}
